headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.1-modder.16
summary: This release syncs upstream's Google Play download feature — Minecraft can now be downloaded and installed straight from Google Play inside the launcher — and fixes the 32-bit (armeabi-v7a) crash reported against v1.6.1-modder.15: the launcher no longer calls System.load on libpairipcore.so, whose JNI_OnLoad aborted the process during launch. Real-device testing on 32-bit phones still decides the next step, since the maintainer has no armeabi-v7a hardware.

items.text: 32-bit testers: if your phone is 32-bit-only (for example a POCO C3) and you have Minecraft 1.26.62.1 installed from Google Play, please try the armeabi-v7a APK from this release and report in the linked issue whether the game launches. The crash you reported in #86 is fixed here, but your device confirms it.

Synced from upstream: download Minecraft directly from Google Play inside the launcher, aligned with LeviLauncher for Windows — a new Download tab handles Play sign-in and download progress styled with the launcher accent color, and the finished split APKs install into a profile like a regular import.

Fixed 32-bit (armeabi-v7a) launches of Google Play installs crashing with a native SIGABRT inside libpairipcore.so's JNI_OnLoad on v1.6.1-modder.15 ("java_class == null in call to RegisterNatives"): the launcher no longer System.load's libpairipcore.so and lets libminecraftpe.so resolve it as a DT_NEEDED dependency instead, exactly like the 64-bit path always did (issue #86).
